services.name: Wine Tours
services.desc: Tour the wineries in style, with Ikon Adventures. We now offer personalized trips to every must-see destination winery in the Okanagan. Whether you are a Valley local or touring the area, a day spent at any of these wineries is certain to leave a lasting memory. Get in for a ride that will take you to your favourite wineries with an incredible viewpoint that you can only get at this height! A large 61-acre property only a short drive from Kelowna’s airport, 50th Parallel has a reputation for beautiful and unique sights around every corner. services.name: Heli Yoga
services.desc: Take flight for an exhilarating helicopter ride and enjoy stunning aerial views of the Okanagan before landing on a mountaintop with a breathtaking 360-degree double lake view. Here we will flow through a private yoga class in the fresh alpine air, followed by a mouth-watering picnic of delicious local wine and cheese, with plenty of time for photos and taking in the panoramic views of the valley. Sarah Daniels offers a down to earth approach to bring the body into balance from the root, educating her clients with the tools and resources to make a lasting change.
